content: The action BswMTimerAction BSWM_TIMER_START shall reload the referenced BswMTimer (via BswMTimerRef ) with the corresponding timer value (refer BswMTimerValue) and change the mode of the timer to BSWM_TIMER_ STARTED.

The action BswMTimerAction BSWM_TIMER_START shall reload the referenced BswMTimer (via BswMTimerRef ) with the corresponding timer value (refer BswMTimerValue) and change the mode of the timer to BSWM_TIMER_ STARTED.
